user.title: Connect to Kilonaut
user.description: Paste your personal Kilonaut API token. You can create one in Kilonaut under Settings → API & Home Assistant.

entities.title: Choose your wallbox sensors
entities.description: Pick the sensors that measure your wallbox. Kilonaut detects a charge from the power draw and calculates the energy from the counter.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Kilonaut. Check your internet connection.
error.invalid_auth: That API token was rejected. Copy it again from Kilonaut.

abort.already_configured: This Kilonaut account is already set up.
